text: No Tag-backs! is an achievement earned from defeating Teron'gor in Auchindoun under the effects of Curtain of Flame on Heroic difficulty. Curtain of Flame is a debuff obtained from Azzakel, so two players must bounce the debuff back and forth on the way to Teron'gor, and maintain it during the fight. This is a personal achievement, so if the whole party needs it, they must share the Curtain of Flame and make sure it doesn't run out when Teron'gor is knocked down at 10% health.
Nixxie is a goblin quest giver located at Lunarfall and Frostwall.
Nixod's Chain-Threshed Spaulders are a world drop from level 76 - 81 Northrend mobs.
Nimble Burnished Cloak is created with Leatherworking (1); taught by Pattern: Nimble Burnished Cloak.
Nik Steelrings is a goblin engineering plans trader found in Warspear's Gallywix's Garage of Ashran.

__NOTOC__ Nimi Brightcastle is a blood elf quest giver located Vol'mar, the main Horde base in Tanaan Jungle. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge. She later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Nita was stationed aboard the Warchief's Fist which resided off the coast of Tanaris, which caused the Alliance to send the Elwynn to observe.
Nikki the Gossip is a goblin located at the Hall of Shadows in Dalaran.

Ninjas can be found in Jaguero Isle. According to "Dead-Eye" Drederick McGumm they are a part of a gang of "Masked hooligans" that follow the Bloodsail around in an "Eternal Battle". In-game you are not normally able to view these creatures, even with normal methods of invisibility detection or hunter tracking; only with the use of Dead-Eye's Flare Gun is it possible to see and interact with them.

Nizka is the younger daughter of Nokrar and Kagra and would follow her parents, along with her siblings, when they left the clan to join the Horde. However en route they would be attacked and the children would become separated from their parents, but thanks to the timely arrival of the draenei the children would be safely escorted back to the Frostwolves. They later be reunited with their mother when Durotan returned with her, though the children would learn that their father was dead killed by the Redwalkers. After travelling through the to Azeroth, Nizka and her siblings was eventually killed by the other orcs of the Horde, following the Frostwolves' meeting with the humans of Stormwind.
Nika Futterman is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
The Niskaran Executioner is a jailer sucking the soul out of Alora's body on Darkstone Isle off the Broken Shore during Out of the Darkness.
Nobleborn Warpcasters are nightborne located in the Nighthold and its instance.

__NOTOC__ Noblegarden Bunny is an item that summons Noblegarden Bunny, a rabbit companion. During Noblegarden, a player may be transformed into a Noblegarden Bunny when picking up a Brightly Colored Egg.

Nisstina is a jungle troll rogue. She has a worg pup minipet. She first appeared during the war against the Lich King as a stealthed Scout Nisstina in Dalaran's Underbelly. She was also present during the purge of Dalaran. During the Burning Legion's third invasion she moved to the Hall of Shadows as Assassin Nisstina where she is in stealth alongside her wolf companion, Ged, standing next to the deceased Unwary Adventurer.
Niko is a goblin located in Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. He assists Vivica Starshot.

The Niuzao sentinels is an order of the defenders of Niuzao Temple and the wardens of the Sha of Fear. in the Townlong Steppes. They are recognized by their uniforms and serve Niuzao himself, who they consider their patron. They are commanded by Sentinel Commander Qipan. During the events of the invasion of Pandaria, the sentinels and the Temple were attacked by the mantid. They were assisted by the adventurers of the Alliance and Horde.

and his courtiers in Stormwind Keep.]] The nobles of Stormwind are the aristocratic ruling class of the kingdom of Stormwind. The most influential of them are members of the House of Nobles, and are mainly royal advisors who have major leverage over business and labor, due to the fact that they own much of the land themselves. They have clashed with the monarch on more than one occasion, but the monarchy has recently learned to not let the nobles push them around anymore. During the Noblegarden, which is meant to bring communities together to share the joy of life and friendship, it is customary for the nobles and lords of Stormwind to hide coins, candy, and the occasional treasures within s

Unlike the other human nations of the Seven Kingdoms, the nation of Dalaran is not ruled by traditional aristocracy and an associated class of nobles. It is, instead, a magocracy ruled by a magus senate known as the Kirin Tor. There are only two known nobles associated with Dalaran: Baron Ulrik von Stromhearth and Baroness Zildjia. It is possible, however, that their titles of nobility aren't associated to Dalaran, but to their eventual home country, like Jaina Proudmoore and Kael'thas Sunstrider, who were aristocrats from other nations.
' Unity Square (from left to right: Stormsong, Proudmoore, Ashvane, and Waycrest).]] The nobles of Kul Tiras are the ruling class of the Admiralty of Kul Tiras.

The nobles of Stromgarde are the ruling class of the kingdom of Stromgarde. There is only one known noble family associated with the kingdom, the Trollbanes, but more did exist at least up until the Second War. Stromgarde also deployed knights during the conflict, implying the presence of a gentry among the nation. In modern times, the caretakers present in the crypt of Stromgarde are guarding family heirlooms of the nobility.

Nikolon, initially seen as Disciple Nikolon and then as Fallen Disciple Nikolon, is a kyrian located in Bastion. After being given a new physical form, Nikolon was a deeply empathic soul who found himself unable to let go of his emotions and chose to join the Forsworn, rather than endure the pain of ascension. However, after experiencing the horrors of the Maw, he led many Forsworn back to Bastion and aided in the reuniting of the Kyrian Covenant.

Nilganihmaht Control Ring is a crawling hand mount granted to players who return the five rings to the Hand of Nilganihmaht at in the Hollow of the Insolent of The Rift in the Maw and then complete the Gotta Hand It To Ya quest. Four rings (gold, runed, signet, and silver) can be acquired at any time. The stone ring requires the Necrolord Assault to be active, and specifically, the Putting A Plan Together quest to be available. The runed band requires proper access to the Rift (via a Repaired Riftkey or a Collapsing Riftstone).

Nilganihmaht's Silver Ring can be found inside the Domination Sealed Chest at in Desmotaeron of the Maw. The chest is locked four times over and will need 4x Seal Breaker Key to open all the domination locks. The four keys can be found: *Inside Helgarde Supply Caches scattered about Desmotaeron *Kjellrun has one hanging on the wall at on The Harrower's Key Ring *As drops from Maldraxxi Defectors and House of the Chosen elites with a low drop rate *In the Feeder's Hand and Key which drops from Ylva at This ring is one of five for the Nilganihmaht Control Ring mount, acquired in The Rift of the Maw.

Nilganihmaht's Stone Ring is created by recovering the four Quartered Ancient Ring items found spread throughout Perdition Hold during the Necrolord Assault. Nilganihmaht's Signet Ring drops from Exos, Herald of Domination atop the Altar of Domination in Perdition Hold of the Maw. One of five required for the Nilganihmaht Control Ring crawling hand mount, players must use the Domination's Calling to access the spawn location and summon the rare.

Northern Lordaeron is an unofficial name used to refer to the unnamed closed zone in Lordaeron, wedged between the northeastern border of the Western Plaguelands, the northwestern border of the Eastern Plaguelands, and the southwestern border of the Ghostlands. Lore-wise, this area may have been part of the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, or of the Kingdom of Quel'Thalas. According to the map in World of Warcraft: Chronicle Volume 2, this area straddles the boundary between both kingdoms and has a bay in it which should be the location of the port of Stratholme. Moreover, this region must be the place where the Thondroril River is born geographically.

North Tide's Run is the name given to the northwestern shoreline of Silverpine Forest. The region includes the beach and a thin strip of the Great Sea. The most prominent feature of the run is the partially submerged ship that lies at the edge of the water. Wallace the Blind has setup a small campfire near the waters by the sunken Horde ship.

The Noonshade Ruins are ancient troll ruins located to the east of Gadgetzan in northeastern Tanaris. Previously overrun by Wastewander bandits, the area was flooded and abandoned during the Cataclysm.

North Point Tower was built by Theramore in northern Dustwallow Marsh, near a well-traveled stretch of road. It is staffed by a sizable contingent of Theramore Guards who have imprisoned a blood elf of the Horde here. The prisoner has a friend in Brackenwall Village who pleads passerbies to rescue her. The scout tower is the most distant of Theramore's outpost since the deserters took over Lost Point.

Following the split of the Order during the Fourth War, she is no longer a member of the Silver Hand.

The North Sanctum is an arcane sanctum located southwest of Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. Ley-Keeper Caidanis stands watch outside. Prospector Anvilward, a dwarf spy sent to observe the effects of the malfunction of the West Sanctum, is present here. After being discovered, adventurers are tasked with killing him.

The Northern Barrens is the northern half of what was once the Barrens. Before being divided it extended into Southern Barrens without break; the two areas are now separated by the Great Divide. It serves as a proving ground for young Horde warriors, ready to seek glory in the name of their people. During the events of Battlefield: Barrens, this zone is contested for characters level 85 and up. Mobs associated with Battlefield: Barrens are rather than for characters below 85.

Northern Stranglethorn (also referred to as Stranglethorn Jungle and Northern Stranglethorn Vale) is a zone in southern Eastern Kingdoms. It is part of the greater Stranglethorn Vale region, separated from the Cape of Stranglethorn by The Sundering. This dense, tropical and resource-filled jungle has holdings of many factions whose agendas conflict or intertwine in the zone's story. The jungle troll instance Zul'Gurub is located here.

North Tide's Beachhead is the shore in northwestern Silverpine Forest currently under the control of Bloodfang worgen. This is the location where two of the three Horde ships filled with reinforcements and a drunken crew built a small camp before being defeated by the feral worgen. The third ship sank just north of here at the Skittering Dark.
Nogg's Machine Shop is an engineering shop found in the Drag in Orgrimmar. It is run by goblins with the Horde.

The Northern Headlands is a region running along the Greymane Wall in northwestern Gilneas. There is no incentive to go here during the worgen starting experience, but Forsaken players quest here in the Ruins of Gilneas. During Forsaken questing, the area extends into what was is the Northgate Woods since the latter subzone does not display. It is mostly peaceful save for the presence of Korok the Colossus, a giant ettin who wanders around the area. It is also home to Gilnean Hounds and Highlands Foxes, of interest to hunters interested in obtaining one of these new pets. The western portion contains several wandering rams and sheep around many ruins. During the Horde questing experience in

The Northern Rocketway Exchange is a station of the Bilgewater Cartel Rocketway, west of the Darnassian Base Camp. It contains a mailbox, forge and cooking fires, which include a grill with some unusual delicacies. The Rocket-jockey will greet successful arrivals with, "Welcome to the Northern Rocketway Exchange! We at Rocketway Relations are glad you survived that last turn!"
Northern Stranglethorn Quests is a quest achievement earned by completing Northern Stranglethorn storylines. Requirement for the meta-achievement Loremaster of Eastern Kingdoms.
Northern Barrens Quests is a horde-only quest achievement earned for completing specific storylines in Northern Barrens. Horde-only requirement for the meta-achievement Loremaster of Kalimdor.
Nomarch Teneth is a quest giver at the Tahret Grounds in Uldum.

Nordrassil Inn is the inn beneath Nordrassil atop Mount Hyjal. This is also the main base of operations for the Guardians of Hyjal. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, the inn was slightly damaged.

Northern Stranglethorn is a level 20-25 zone in southern Eastern Kingdoms for both the Horde and Alliance. It starts out separated, with the Alliance going to the Rebel Camp in the north and the Horde going to Grom'gol Base Camp on the western coast. The overarching story for the whole zone revolves around a Lashtail Hatchling. and his crew still offer the quests involving hunting the local wildlife. (Tigers, and Panthers, and Raptors, Oh My!) The progress for the storyline is tracked in the achievement Northern Stranglethorn Quests.

Nordune Ridge, named after Nordu, is a cliff in the Regrowth which serves as the invasion point into the Firelands. After the surrounding area is restored by Aessina and Nordu's death, this ridge will have a large tree (which appears clickable, but does nothing) until players have completed the Mount Hyjal quest chain.

Norbin Nimblesprocket is a gnome found sitting in a tower in Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens. Next to him are Screws and Gears. He survived the Razing of Northwatch Hold and was encountered by the Horde champions when they came to install goblin :Azerite cannons on the northern shore of the Great Divide at Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens during the Fourth War.

Norkani is one of four scouts serving Blood Guard Hakkuz who were captured while scouting to learn more about the Zandalari presence inside Zul'Aman. She is being held in a cage. Saving Norkani within the time limit grants access to Norkani's Package.
Noodles is a cooking supplies vendor at the Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds.
North Wind Tavern is the inn of Zouchin Village, in the Zouchin Province of northeastern Kun-Lai Summit. Liu Ze is the innkeeper behind the bar.

The Nook of Konk is a small cave located along the Ascent of Swirling Winds behind some ancient mogu ruins in the Jade Forest. Konk, a minor leader of the Forest Hozen calls the nook home. The ground is littered with Horde bottles. After Konk is killed, Zin'Jun dies and the surviving Horde attack force members (General Nazgrim, Sergeant Gorrok, Rivett Clutchpop, Shademaster Kiryn, and Shokia) leave Honeydew Village to make their way into the cave, making it a temporary base. Merchant Zin follows them waiting outside the cave.
Norlaxx is a level 89 rare mogu located just south of Kri'vess in the Townlong Steppes. Norlaxx is a pandarian champion.
Norissis is a rare chimaera located just west of the Hidden Grove in Winterspring.
None Shall Pass is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Amalgam of Corruption in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance without allowing any unleashed corruption to fuse with it.
Noodle Cart Kit is a cooking item used primarily for raiding. It produces Noodle Soup for party members.
Norah Titus is a Forsaken found in Warspear's Forsaken section of Ashran, talking with Taner Duman.
__NOTOC__ Norana Quelldawn is a blood elf located at Deathweb Hollow in Talador.
Noodle-Maker Monmon is a hozen noodle vendor located at the Celestial Tournament in the Timeless Isle.

Nok-Karosh is a gigantic garn who dwells north of Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge. He drops the mount Garn Nighthowl upon defeat, but players should take heed: he will take them out in one bite, so the only option is to weaken the monster with minions/pets.
__NOTOC__ The North Fleet Reservists are draenei, dwarves, and humans located on ships in the Frozen Sea in the Howling Fjord.

Nomi is a pandaren cook. Since he was a young cub, he was eager to learn everything he could about cooking. Many folks who were passing by helped him to along with few words of advice or a recipe or two. He is encountered by players first as a boy in Pandaria. Some years later, now as a grown pandaren, Nomi becomes a cook in Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ Nonn Threeratchet is a goblin blacksmithing plans trader found behind Warspear's Gallywix's Garage of Ashran.
Nochtadh, Footpads of the Deft Assasin did not make it out of the Legion alpha.
Noel Harrison is a forsaken follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Nolan North is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Non-Lethal Enforcer is an achievement earned from killing Tyrant Velhari in on Normal difficulty or higher without killing the Ancient Enforcer.
Nok'thuul is a doomguard that appears at Legion Invasion locations.

Nora Kittridge is a human who can be found outside the First to Your Aid shop in Dalaran in the Broken Isles, appearing after Argus did in the sky. She was brought on to assist the first aid team after they were overwhelmed by Dalaran citizens who were suffering from a strange affliction. Nora spends her time treating the citizens that are waiting or sitting outside the packed building.

North Sea Sharks are sharks located in Icecrown. During the war against the Lich King, The Silver Blade and The Wavecrest for the Silver Covenant, The Crimson Dawn and the The Firehawk for the Sunreavers, were fishing those sharks when they weren't fighting the kvaldir on the Sea Reaver's Run.
The Nomad's Spiked Tent is a placable tent that provides a stat bonus if rested in.
North Pass Caverns, also called Northern Caverns, is a location in Drustvar.
Nordrassil Druids are night elves and tauren located in Mount Hyjal.
Nolpe is a siren located in the Wailing Tideways in Tiragarde Sound.
Noelle is a house cat located at the Snug Harbor Inn in Boralus.

Nokano is a Zandalari troll located in the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. During Talanji's coronation, he defended B'wizati from a Rioting Zocalo Drudge.

Nondumiso Tembe is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Nokali the Scarred is a Zandalari troll located in the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.

Northfold Crossing is a crossroads located in front of Ar'gorok in the Arathi Highlands. It is the last foothold buffering the Horde stronghold from the Alliance during the Battle for Stromgarde. There is a small camp with two siege towers defending the intersection from invaders. However, should the foothold fall to the Alliance, the siege towers will lie in ruins.
Northfold Arbalests are human crossbowmen located in the Arathi Highlands. They also participate in the Battle for Stromgarde.
Northfold Axe Throwers are jungle trolls located in the Arathi Highlands. They also participate in the Battle for Stromgarde.
Northfold Defenders are humans located in the Arathi Highlands. They also participate in the Battle for Stromgarde.
Northfold Grenadiers are goblins located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Northfold Grunts are orcs located in Northfold Crossing in the Arathi Highlands. They also participate in the Battle for Stromgarde.
Nort is a tortollan located at the Seekers' Vista in Stormsong Valley. He will appear to welcome the adventurer during the completion of Battle Victorious and Turtle Tactics.
Norobi is a tortollan located at the Seekers' Vista in Stormsong Valley. He will appear to welcome the adventurer during the completion of Battle Victorious and Turtle Tactics.

Nordrathon is a nathrezim set to appear at the in Tanaan Jungle.
Norm da Harms is a Zandalari troll whose skull can be found at the Head Shop in Dazar'alor.

__NOTOC__ Noisul of Many Faces is a boggart (shapeshifted into a wicker brute) roaming the top of the Gossamer Cliffs in Ardenweald. It is blessed by Mueh'zala and has scared the silkstrider matriarch Ol' Gertie to death.
Nolon is a sylvar innkeeper located at Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald.
__NOTOC__ Nocturnus the Unraveler is an elite Maw necromancer located in a cave adjacent to the Scholar's Den in Korthia.
Nort the Noxious is a Maldraxxi necromancer encountered by adventure companions in the Stitchyard in Maldraxxus.

The Nokhud Traditionalist's Pauldrons drop from Balakar Khan in the Nokhud Offensive.
Nokhud Reaver Crushers are a quest reward from Taken By Storm in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Noriko the All-Remembering is a human located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Norilune is a dryad located near the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. A group of Exuberant Foals can be found in front of her.
Nokhudon Apprentices are centaur located at Nokhudon Hold in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
